name: collab-editor
description: Real-time collaborative document editor: Yjs CRDT + Tiptap + Express + ws, with debounced snapshot persistence, presence, JWT auth and sharing.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
